comparison.objective: Candidate removes a fan; record takes an ear temperature.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid module extraction versus gentle probe insertion, button press, precise still hold, and post-reading placement.
comparison.success_condition: Fan safely removed for 3 s versus seated probe within depth/alignment limits, valid 3 s measurement, no painful over-insertion, then released on table.
comparison.reason: The record tests delicate human-contact probing and timed sensing, not maintenance-module removal.
